description: Clip Overlay Update - Replace the 3-line drawtext overlay with a 5-line metadata overlay (Time, Player, Outcome+Attempt, Filename, Note ID) visible for the first 2 seconds, with white text and a #131211 2px border. Single-file change to clip/processor.go.

userStories.title: Update clip overlay drawtext filter to 5-line layout with border
userStories.description: As a user, I want the exported clip to show a 5-line metadata overlay in the bottom-left for the first 2 seconds so I can immediately identify the clip.
acceptanceCriteria: clip/processor.go — processClip() drawtext filter produces exactly 5 drawtext segments chained with commas in a single -vf value
Line 2 (y=h-th-36): text=Filename\: {c.Filename} — c.Filename has colons replaced with \\: via strings.ReplaceAll
Line 3 (y=h-th-72): text=Outcome\: {outcome} {c.Attempt} — outcome already has colons escaped
Line 4 (y=h-th-108): text=Player\: {player} — c.Player has colons replaced with \\: via strings.ReplaceAll, stored in a 'player' variable
Line 5 (top, y=h-th-144): text=Time\: {startTimestamp}/{endTimestamp} — endTimestamp is computed from c.End using the same %02d\\:%02d\\:%02d format as the existing startTimestamp
Every drawtext segment has enable=lt(t\\,2) — 2 seconds (changed from 3)
fontsize=28, fontcolor=white, x=10 unchanged on all lines
